name: hcportal_updateKennelWebsite
description: Updates a kennel's HC6 public website configuration in HC.KennelWebsite. Update-only — the row is created on kennel insert via the TR_Kennel_AfterInsert_CreateKennelWebsite trigger. All style and content parameters use COALESCE so omitted parameters preserve existing values. Nullable NVARCHAR fields use the empty-string sentinel: sending '' sets the column to NULL (clears the value); omitting the parameter leaves it unchanged.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device GUID from the portal's device-bound token system. Accepts NULL so SQL can return a structured error rather than causing an execution failure.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived (30s) cryptographic token generated from the device shared secret.

parameters.name: publicKennelId
parameters.description: Routing: the kennel to update. Resolved to HC.Kennel.id internally. Accepts NULL so SQL can return a structured error.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the public website is enabled. NULL = no change.

parameters.name: themeMode
parameters.description: Theme mode: 'light' or 'dark'. Validated — any other value returns an error. NULL = no change.

parameters.name: primaryColor
parameters.description: Primary brand colour (CSS hex). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: accentColor
parameters.description: Secondary accent colour (CSS hex). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: scrollBlur
parameters.description: Hero scroll blur intensity 0–100. Validated — out-of-range returns an error. NULL = no change.

parameters.name: customDomain
parameters.description: Tier 3 custom domain (e.g. 'lh3.com'). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: urlShortcode
parameters.description: Legacy HC5 URL shortcode. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: bannerImage
parameters.description: Hero/header banner image URL. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: ogImageUrl
parameters.description: Open Graph image URL. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: backgroundImage
parameters.description: Page background image URL. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: titleTextColor
parameters.description: Heading text colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: bodyTextColor
parameters.description: Body text colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: textMutedColor
parameters.description: Secondary/label text colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: cardBackgroundColor
parameters.description: Card/panel surface colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: buttonPrimaryColor
parameters.description: Primary action button background (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: buttonCancelColor
parameters.description: Cancel/undo action button background (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: buttonSecondaryColor
parameters.description: Secondary (non-primary, non-cancel) button background (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: runCardColor
parameters.description: Run card surface colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: backgroundColor
parameters.description: HC5 legacy page background overlay colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: menuBackgroundColor
parameters.description: Sticky nav background colour (#RRGGBBAA). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: menuTextColor
parameters.description: Sticky nav text colour. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: titleFont
parameters.description: HC5 legacy title font name. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: bodyFont
parameters.description: HC5 legacy body font name. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: titleText
parameters.description: Custom hero display name (distinct from KennelName). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: tagline
parameters.description: Short strapline. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: welcomeText
parameters.description: Homepage welcome/intro copy. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: seoTitle
parameters.description: Per-tenant <title> tag (max 60 chars). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: seoDescription
parameters.description: Per-tenant <meta description> (max 155 chars). '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: seoStructuredDataJson
parameters.description: JSON-LD structured data override. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: mismanagementDescription
parameters.description: Mis-management page intro copy. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: mismanagementJson
parameters.description: Committee contacts as JSON. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: extraMenusJson
parameters.description: Custom nav items as JSON. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: contactDetailsJson
parameters.description: Contact details as JSON. '' clears to NULL; NULL = no change.

parameters.name: controlFlags
parameters.description: HC5 legacy feature toggle bitflags. NULL = no change. Note: the SP has a dead CASE WHEN @controlFlags = '' check that can never fire on INT — harmless but inert.

rowsets.name: ErrorResult
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, validation error, or kennel not found — in place of SuccessResult.

codeSmells.issue: Dead sentinel check on INT column
codeSmells.detail: controlFlags uses CASE WHEN @controlFlags = '' THEN NULL which can never be true on an INT parameter. The COALESCE path still works correctly — the CASE is simply dead code.

breakingChangeRules: Never change the empty-string sentinel meaning for NVARCHAR fields
Never change the resultCode value (1 = success) without updating all callers
Never change the SuccessResult column names (result, resultCode) without updating all callers
